fold_baseline: best single model by mean utility using outer-fold train only
embedding: local frozen e5-small-v2 mean pooling, no fine-tuning
regressor: shared plus model-intercept plus model-specific interaction Ridge(alpha=10)
utility_variance: sample variance across the three repeat-level utilities
selective_rule: switch only when max one-sided 90% ensemble LCB = mean-1.645*std > 0
pass_action: freeze C3 method; do not run FRAR; prepare a new outcome-blind holdout
fail_action: C3_DEVELOPMENT_FAIL; stop without new data collection
